title: Glass Core Substrates – Next Generation Advanced Packaging Platform for AI and HPC
notes: 10-2-10 (24-layer) glass core panel 510x515 mm with Cu-filled LAE TGVs and 2 EMIBs; TSC 750 on cores; warpage 64 vs 143 um; glass waveguides. Almost no dimensions.

title: 0.5 µm Pitch Wafer-to-wafer Hybrid Bonding with SiCN Bonding Interface for Advanced Memory
notes: Six-level Cu/SiCN W2W via-to-via TV on 300 mm, 0.5-1.2 um pitch, 200-600 nm CD; 350 C 2 h anneal; ~1 nm dishing; 0.67-2.34 ohm/link chains.

title: Confined IMCs for low temperature and high throughput D2W bonding
notes: CoSn3 pre-IMC (270 C, 1 min) confined in oxide cavities, Ni/Sn top bumps, TCB 150 C + CUF; ~95% single-bump yield at 20/10/7 um pitch (text says 90%).
